title: Aadhaar App
section: How to share contact card through Aadhaar app? Can Name, Gender, Email, and DoB be updated through the Aadhaar app? Currently, these updates are not available through the Aadhaar app. For these updates, ANH may visit the nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra or Aadhaar update and enrolment centre. In the future, these services may be made available in the Aadhaar App in phased manner. Can Photo, Fingerprints, and Iris details be updated through the Aadhaar app? No, the biometric details (Photo, Fingerprints, and Iris) can only be updated by visiting an Aadhaar Seva Kendra or the Aadhaar enrolment and update centre. Can this app be used at places where physical copies of Aadhaar are currently requested? Yes. The Aadhaar app is an official application developed and managed by UIDAI. The app allows an Aadhaar Number Holder (ANH) to securely share their Aadhaar data with an Offline Verification Seeking Entity (OVSE), as per their consent and choice. Can we lock/unlock Biometrics with this app? Yes. The Aadhaar app provides a one-click biometric lock/unlock facility, which helps keep Aadhaar data safe and secure. Can a user create multiple profiles on the Aadhaar app? Yes, any individual with a valid Aadhaar number can create up to five profiles on the Aadhaar app. How to add the profile of a minor in the app? A minor (below 18 years of age) can be added to the Aadhaar app if their relationship with the guardian was established through biometric authentication at the time of Aadhaar enrolment. The minor enters their Aadhaar number, after which the guardian completes face authentication. Once the guardian’s face authentication is successful, the minor’s profile is added to the app. If the Mandatory Biometric Update (MBU) of the minor has already been completed, the minor will perform face authentication instead of the guardian. Can this app be used outside India? No, the Aadhaar app cannot be used outside India. Why does the app need different permissions, such as camera, SMS, and call ? Call and SMS permissions are required for SIM-based device binding, similar to payment apps. These permissions help identify the active SIM and securely send or read verification SMS. Camera permission is required for face authentication and verification to access Aadhaar services. What is an Aadhaar Verifiable Credential in the context of the Aadhaar App?
